top_signals.title: Ethereum Foundation launches zkAPI to let users pay for AI models without revealing identity
top_signals.summary: Users deposit funds into an Ethereum vault and authorize spending with zero-knowledge proofs, so the API provider can't link requests to a payer.

top_signals.title: Bond Storm Shakes London’s Fragile Stocks Recovery
top_signals.summary: A tentative recovery in UK stocks has hit a major roadblock as the country’s bonds take some of the harshest punishment from the global selloff in sovereign debt.

top_signals.title: Wetherspoon boss attacks Labour for ‘high street dereliction’ as profit falls
top_signals.summary: Pub chain Wetherspoon has hit out at the government for causing “high street dereliction” by hiking taxes, as the company’s profit slipped by a quarter.  The London-listed pub group saw revenue jump by five per cent to £2.2bn in the year to July – in line with analyst forecasts – though pre-tax profit fell further [...]
